title.en: Maths tutor: from listing to the parents who find you
title.af: Wiskunde-tutor: van advertensie tot die ouers wat jou vind
title.zu: Umfundisi wezibalo: kusukela esikhangisweni kuya kubazali abakutholayo
title.xh: Umfundisi weMathematika: ukusuka kwintengiso ukuya kubazali abakufumanayo
title.nso: Morutiši wa dipalo: go tloga papatšong go ya go batswadi bao ba go hwetšago

chapters.nso: Baithuti ba gago ba ka mehla

en: Open Quick, go to [[Tutors]] and tap [[Offer tutoring]]
Swipe the doors until you see Tutors. One tap starts your listing.
af: Maak Quick oop, gaan na [[Tutors]] en tik [[Offer tutoring]]
Swiep deur die deure tot jy Tutors sien. Een tik begin jou advertensie.
zu: Vula i-Quick, iya ku-[[Tutors]] bese uthepha [[Offer tutoring]]
Swayipha iminyango uze ubone i-Tutors. Ukuthepha kanye kuqala isikhangiso sakho.
xh: Vula i-Quick, yiya kwi-[[Tutors]] uze ucofe [[Offer tutoring]]
Tyibilikisa iingcango ude ubone i-Tutors. Ukucofa kanye kuqalisa intengiso yakho.
nso: Bula Quick, eya go [[Tutors]] gomme o kgotle [[Offer tutoring]]
Šuthiša mabati go fihlela o bona Tutors. Go kgotla gatee go thoma papatšo ya gago.

en: Pick your subject
Maths, Science, English, Accounting, Afrikaans or Coding. Teach something else? Tap [[Another option]] and type it.
af: Kies jou vak
Wiskunde, Wetenskap, Engels, Rekeningkunde, Afrikaans of Kodering. Gee jy iets anders? Tik [[Another option]] en tik dit in.
zu: Khetha isifundo sakho
Izibalo, iSayensi, isiNgisi, ukuBalwa kwezimali, isiBhunu noma ukuKhoda. Ufundisa okunye? Thepha [[Another option]] bese usibhala.
xh: Khetha isifundo sakho
IMathematika, iSayensi, isiNgesi, uBalo-mali, isiBhulu okanye ukuKhowuda. Ufundisa enye into? Cofa [[Another option]] uze uyibhale.
nso: Kgetha thuto ya gago
Dipalo, Saense, Seisimane, Tšhomišo ya Ditšhelete, Seburu goba Khouto. O ruta se sengwe? Kgotla [[Another option]] gomme o se ngwale.

en: Pick the level you teach
[[Primary]], [[High school]], [[Matric]] or [[University]]. You can change it in TrustSquare later.
af: Kies die vlak waarop jy onderrig gee
[[Primary]], [[High school]], [[Matric]] of [[University]]. Jy kan dit later in TrustSquare verander.
zu: Khetha izinga ofundisa kulo
[[Primary]], [[High school]], [[Matric]] noma [[University]]. Ungalishintsha ku-TrustSquare kamuva.
xh: Khetha inqanaba ofundisa kulo
[[Primary]], [[High school]], [[Matric]] okanye [[University]]. Ungalitshintsha kwi-TrustSquare kamva.
nso: Kgetha maemo ao o rutago go ona
[[Primary]], [[High school]], [[Matric]] goba [[University]]. O ka a fetoša go TrustSquare ka morago.

en: Online, in person, or both
Tap how you teach. Parents who want lessons at home find you if you tap [[In person]] or [[Both]].
af: Aanlyn, persoonlik, of albei
Tik hoe jy onderrig gee. Ouers wat lesse by die huis wil hê, vind jou as jy [[In person]] of [[Both]] tik.
zu: Ku-inthanethi, ubuso nobuso, noma kokubili
Thepha ukuthi ufundisa kanjani. Abazali abafuna izifundo ekhaya bayakuthola uma uthepha [[In person]] noma [[Both]].
xh: Kwi-intanethi, ubuso ngobuso, okanye zombini
Cofa indlela ofundisa ngayo. Abazali abafuna izifundo ekhaya bayakufumana ukuba ucofa [[In person]] okanye [[Both]].
nso: Inthaneteng, sefahlego ka sefahlego, goba ka bobedi
Kgotla ka mo o rutago ka gona. Batswadi bao ba nyakago dithuto gae ba a go hwetša ge o kgotla [[In person]] goba [[Both]].

en: Set your rate per hour
Type what an hour of your teaching is worth. Quick shows the legal minimum so you never go below it.
af: Stel jou tarief per uur
Tik wat 'n uur van jou onderrig werd is. Quick wys die wettige minimum sodat jy nooit laer gaan nie.
zu: Beka imali yakho ngehora
Bhala ukuthi ihora lokufundisa kwakho libiza malini. I-Quick ikhombisa okuncane okuvunyelwe umthetho ukuze ungehli ngaphansi kwakho.
xh: Misela ixabiso lakho ngeyure
Bhala ukuba iyure yokufundisa kwakho ixabisa malini. I-Quick ibonisa ubuncinci obuvunyelwe ngumthetho ukuze ungaze wehle ngaphantsi kwabo.
nso: Bea tefo ya gago ka iri
Ngwala gore iri ya go ruta ga gago e bohlokwa gakaakang. Quick e bontšha tefo ye nnyane ya molao gore o se ke wa theogela ka tlase ga yona.

en: Tick the areas where you teach
You can tick more than one; a parent searching any of them finds you.
af: Merk die areas waar jy onderrig gee
Jy kan meer as een merk; 'n ouer wat in enige van hulle soek, vind jou.
zu: Maka izindawo ofundisa kuzo
Ungamaka ezingaphezu kweyodwa; umzali osesha kunoma iyiphi yazo uyakuthola.
xh: Phawula imimandla ofundisa kuyo
Ungaphawula engaphezu komnye; umzali okhangela kuwo nawuphi na uyakufumana.
nso: Swaya mafelo ao o rutago go ona
O ka swaya a fetago le tee; motswadi yo a nyakago go le ge e le lefe la ona o a go hwetša.

en: Check your listing, then save
Your subject, level, how you teach and your rate are on it. Add your first name and email and tap [[Save my listing]].
af: Kyk na jou advertensie en stoor dan
Jou vak, vlak, hoe jy onderrig gee en jou tarief is daarop. Voeg jou voornaam en e-pos by en tik [[Save my listing]].
zu: Hlola isikhangiso sakho, bese ulondoloza
Isifundo sakho, izinga, indlela ofundisa ngayo nemali yakho kukuso. Engeza igama lakho nemeyili bese uthepha [[Save my listing]].
xh: Jonga intengiso yakho, uze uyigcine
Isifundo sakho, inqanaba, indlela ofundisa ngayo nexabiso lakho zikuyo. Yongeza igama lakho ne-imeyile uze ucofe [[Save my listing]].
nso: Lekola papatšo ya gago, ke moka o e boloke
Thuto ya gago, maemo, ka mo o rutago ka gona le tefo ya gago di go yona. Tsenya leina la gago le imeile gomme o kgotle [[Save my listing]].

en: Saved: now sign the terms and publish
Tap [[Sign the terms and publish]], or open the email we sent you. Nobody can see your listing yet.
af: Gestoor: teken nou die bepalings en publiseer
Tik [[Sign the terms and publish]], of maak die e-pos oop wat ons gestuur het. Niemand kan jou advertensie nog sien nie.
zu: Kulondoloziwe: manje sayina imigomo bese ushicilela
Thepha [[Sign the terms and publish]], noma uvule i-imeyili esikuthumelele yona. Akekho umuntu ongabona isikhangiso sakho okwamanje.
xh: Kugciniwe: ngoku sayina imimiselo uze upapashe
Cofa [[Sign the terms and publish]], okanye uvule i-imeyile esikuthumelele yona. Akukho mntu unokubona intengiso yakho okwangoku.
nso: E bolokilwe: bjale saena melawana gomme o phatlalatše
Kgotla [[Sign the terms and publish]], goba o bule imeile ye re go rometšego yona. Ga go yo a ka bonago papatšo ya gago ga bjale.

en: Add photos of where you teach, and all your subjects
In TrustSquare tap [[Edit]], then [[Add Photo]]: your whiteboard, desk or books, no learners' faces. Add every subject you teach. Then tap [[Save Changes]] to keep them.
af: Voeg foto's by van waar jy onderrig gee, en al jou vakke
Tik in TrustSquare [[Edit]], dan [[Add Photo]]: jou witbord, lessenaar of boeke, geen leerders se gesigte nie. Voeg elke vak by wat jy gee. Tik dan [[Save Changes]] om dit te hou.
zu: Engeza izithombe zalapho ufundisa khona, nazo zonke izifundo zakho
Ku-TrustSquare thepha [[Edit]], bese [[Add Photo]]: ibhodi lakho, itafula noma izincwadi, kungabi nabuso babafundi. Engeza zonke izifundo ozifundisayo. Bese uthepha [[Save Changes]] ukuze uzigcine.
xh: Yongeza iifoto zalapho ufundisa khona, nazo zonke izifundo zakho

Kwi-TrustSquare cofa [[Edit]], emva koko [[Add Photo]]: ibhodi yakho, idesika okanye iincwadi, kungabikho buso babafundi. Yongeza zonke izifundo ozifundisayo. Emva koko cofa [[Save Changes]] ukuze uzigcine.
nso: Tsenya diswantšho tša moo o rutago gona, le dithuto tša gago ka moka

Go TrustSquare kgotla [[Edit]], ke moka [[Add Photo]]: boto ya gago, teseke goba dipuku, go se be le difahlego tša baithuti. Tsenya thuto ye nngwe le ye nngwe yeo o e rutago. Ke moka kgotla [[Save Changes]] go di boloka.

en: Accept the seller terms once
Read them, tick both boxes at the end and tap [[I accept]].
af: Aanvaar die verkopersbepalings een keer
Lees hulle, merk albei blokkies aan die einde en tik [[I accept]].
zu: Yamukela imigomo yabathengisi kanye
Yifunde, maka omabili amabhokisi ekugcineni bese uthepha [[I accept]].
xh: Yamkela imimiselo yabathengisi kanye
Yifunde, phawula zombini iibhokisi ekugqibeleni uze ucofe [[I accept]].
nso: Amogela melawana ya barekiši gatee
E bale, swaya mapokisi a mabedi mafelelong gomme o kgotle [[I accept]].

en: Publish: parents can find you at once
Tap [[Publish]]. Your card shows [[Live]].
af: Publiseer: ouers kan jou dadelik vind
Tik [[Publish]]. Jou kaart wys [[Live]].
zu: Shicilela: abazali bangakuthola ngokushesha
Thepha [[Publish]]. Ikhadi lakho likhombisa [[Live]].
xh: Papasha: abazali banokukufumana kwangoko
Cofa [[Publish]]. Ikhadi lakho libonisa [[Live]].
nso: Phatlalatša: batswadi ba ka go hwetša gona bjale
Kgotla [[Publish]]. Karata ya gago e bontšha [[Live]].

en: Send your Buzz link to your regular students' parents
In [[My Space]], open [[Buzz]] and tap [[Get my link]]. One link for all of them: [[Send on WhatsApp]] or [[Copy]].
af: Stuur jou Buzz-skakel aan die ouers van jou vaste leerders
Maak in [[My Space]] [[Buzz]] oop en tik [[Get my link]]. Een skakel vir almal: [[Send on WhatsApp]] of [[Copy]].
zu: Thumela isixhumanisi sakho se-Buzz kubazali babafundi bakho abajwayelekile
Ku-[[My Space]], vula i-[[Buzz]] bese uthepha [[Get my link]]. Isixhumanisi esisodwa sabo bonke: [[Send on WhatsApp]] noma [[Copy]].
xh: Thumela ikhonkco lakho le-Buzz kubazali babafundi bakho abaqhelekileyo
Kwi-[[My Space]], vula i-[[Buzz]] uze ucofe [[Get my link]]. Ikhonkco elinye labo bonke: [[Send on WhatsApp]] okanye [[Copy]].
nso: Romela kgokagano ya gago ya Buzz go batswadi ba baithuti ba gago ba ka mehla
Go [[My Space]], bula [[Buzz]] gomme o kgotle [[Get my link]]. Kgokagano e tee ya bohle: [[Send on WhatsApp]] goba [[Copy]].

en: A regular student's parent joins
She opens your link, ticks the Buzz terms and taps [[Continue]]. Now you can buzz each other.
af: Die ouer van 'n vaste leerder sluit aan
Sy maak jou skakel oop, merk die Buzz-bepalings en tik [[Continue]]. Nou kan julle mekaar buzz.
zu: Umzali womfundi ojwayelekile uyajoyina
Uvula isixhumanisi sakho, amake imigomo ye-Buzz bese ethepha [[Continue]]. Manje ningathumelelana nge-Buzz.
xh: Umzali womfundi oqhelekileyo uyajoyina
Uvula ikhonkco lakho, aphawule imimiselo ye-Buzz aze acofe [[Continue]]. Ngoku ningathumelelana nge-Buzz.
nso: Motswadi wa moithuti wa ka mehla o a tsena
O bula kgokagano ya gago, a swaye melawana ya Buzz gomme a kgotle [[Continue]]. Bjale le ka romelana ka Buzz.

en: She buzzes you about a lesson
One line, straight to your phone: "Can we move Thursday's lesson to 5pm?" If your phone has no push, it comes by email.
af: Sy buzz vir jou oor 'n les
Een reël, reguit na jou foon: "Kan ons Donderdag se les na 17:00 skuif?" As jou foon nie kennisgewings kry nie, kom dit per e-pos.
zu: Ukuthumelela nge-Buzz mayelana nesifundo
Umugqa owodwa, uqonde ocingweni lwakho: "Singasusa isifundo sangoLwesine siye ku-5 ntambama?" Uma ucingo lwakho lungenazo izaziso, kufika nge-imeyili.
xh: Ukuthumelela nge-Buzz malunga nesifundo
Umgca omnye, ngqo kwifowuni yakho: "Singasifudusela isifundo sangoLwesine ku-5 emva kwemini?" Ukuba ifowuni yakho ayinazo izaziso, iza nge-imeyile.
nso: O go romela Buzz ka ga thuto
Mothalo o tee, thwii mogaleng wa gago: "Re ka šuthišetša thuto ya Labone go 5 mathapama?" Ge mogala wa gago o se na ditsebišo, e tla ka imeile.

en: A new parent taps [[Find a tutor]] and picks the subject
Quick's Tutors door, [[Find a tutor]], then the subject her child needs.
af: 'n Nuwe ouer tik [[Find a tutor]] en kies die vak
Quick se Tutors-deur, [[Find a tutor]], dan die vak wat haar kind nodig het.
zu: Umzali omusha uthepha [[Find a tutor]] bese ekhetha isifundo
Umnyango we-Tutors ku-Quick, [[Find a tutor]], bese kuba isifundo ingane yakhe esidingayo.
xh: Umzali omtsha ucofa [[Find a tutor]] aze akhethe isifundo
Ucango lwe-Tutors kwi-Quick, [[Find a tutor]], emva koko isifundo umntwana wakhe asidingayo.
nso: Motswadi yo moswa o kgotla [[Find a tutor]] gomme a kgetha thuto
Lebati la Tutors go Quick, [[Find a tutor]], ke moka thuto yeo ngwana wa gagwe a e hlokago.

en: Then the level
[[Primary]], [[High school]], [[Matric]] or [[University]]: only tutors who teach it are shown.
af: Dan die vlak
[[Primary]], [[High school]], [[Matric]] of [[University]]: net tutors wat dit gee, word gewys.
zu: Bese kuba izinga
[[Primary]], [[High school]], [[Matric]] noma [[University]]: kukhonjiswa kuphela abafundisi abalifundisayo.
xh: Emva koko inqanaba
[[Primary]], [[High school]], [[Matric]] okanye [[University]]: kuboniswa kuphela abafundisi abalifundisayo.
nso: Ke moka maemo
[[Primary]], [[High school]], [[Matric]] goba [[University]]: go bontšhwa feela barutiši bao ba a rutago.

en: Then her area: she finds you
Your listing shows with your rate and trust score, next to examples of what a listing looks like.
af: Dan haar area: sy vind jou
Jou advertensie verskyn met jou tarief en vertrouetelling, langs voorbeelde van hoe 'n advertensie lyk.
zu: Bese kuba indawo yakhe: uyakuthola
Isikhangiso sakho sivela nemali yakho namaphuzu okwethenjwa, eduze nezibonelo zokuthi isikhangiso sibukeka kanjani.
xh: Emva koko ummandla wakhe: uyakufumana
Intengiso yakho ivela nexabiso lakho namanqaku okuthenjwa, ecaleni kwemizekelo yokuba intengiso ijongeka njani.
nso: Ke moka lefelo la gagwe: o a go hwetša
Papatšo ya gago e tšwelela le tefo ya gago le dintlha tša go botwa, kgauswi le mehlala ya ka mo papatšo e lebelelwago ka gona.

en: She sees your subjects, level and how you teach
Your photos are at the top, your rate under them, then your subjects, level and online or in person. Your name and number stay hidden.
af: Sy sien jou vakke, vlak en hoe jy onderrig gee
Jou foto's is bo, jou tarief daaronder, dan jou vakke, vlak en aanlyn of persoonlik. Jou naam en nommer bly versteek.
zu: Ubona izifundo zakho, izinga nendlela ofundisa ngayo
Izithombe zakho ziphezulu, imali yakho ngaphansi kwazo, bese kuba izifundo zakho, izinga nokuthi ku-inthanethi noma ubuso nobuso. Igama lakho nenombolo kuhlala kufihliwe.
xh: Ubona izifundo zakho, inqanaba nendlela ofundisa ngayo
Iifoto zakho ziphezulu, ixabiso lakho ngaphantsi kwazo, emva koko izifundo zakho, inqanaba nokuba kwi-intanethi okanye ubuso ngobuso. Igama lakho nenombolo zihlala zifihliwe.
nso: O bona dithuto tša gago, maemo le ka mo o rutago ka gona
Diswantšho tša gago di godimo, tefo ya gago ka tlase ga tšona, ke moka dithuto tša gago, maemo le ge e le inthaneteng goba sefahlego ka sefahlego. Leina la gago le nomoro di dula di utegile.

en: She asks for an introduction
She writes a short message and taps [[Join queue]]. 1 Tuppence is held from her, and spent only if you accept. Asking twice holds nothing more.
af: Sy vra vir 'n bekendstelling
Sy skryf 'n kort boodskap en tik [[Join queue]]. 1 Tuppence word van haar gehou, en net gebruik as jy aanvaar. As sy twee keer vra, word niks meer gehou nie.
zu: Ucela ukwethulwa
Ubhala umlayezo omfushane bese ethepha [[Join queue]]. I-Tuppence engu-1 iyabanjwa kuye, isetshenziswe kuphela uma wamukela. Ukucela kabili akubambi lutho olunye.
xh: Ucela ukwaziswa
Ubhala umyalezo omfutshane aze acofe [[Join queue]]. I-Tuppence e-1 iyabanjwa kuye, isetyenziswe kuphela ukuba uyamkela. Ukucela kabini akubambi nto yimbi.
nso: O kgopela go tsebišwa
O ngwala molaetša o mokopana gomme a kgotla [[Join queue]]. Tuppence e 1 e swarwa go yena, gomme e šomišwa feela ge o amogela. Go kgopela gabedi ga go swere selo se sengwe.

en: You see her request
Open [[Seller Hub]]. Her message is on your listing's card.
af: Jy sien haar versoek
Maak [[Seller Hub]] oop. Haar boodskap is op jou advertensie se kaart.
zu: Ubona isicelo sakhe
Vula i-[[Seller Hub]]. Umlayezo wakhe usekhadini lesikhangiso sakho.
xh: Ubona isicelo sakhe
Vula i-[[Seller Hub]]. Umyalezo wakhe usekhadini lentengiso yakho.
nso: O bona kgopelo ya gagwe
Bula [[Seller Hub]]. Molaetša wa gagwe o karateng ya papatšo ya gago.

en: You accept
Tap [[Accept]]. It costs you nothing. You both get an email: reply to it to talk. Your email address stays private.
af: Jy aanvaar
Tik [[Accept]]. Dit kos jou niks. Julle kry albei 'n e-pos: antwoord daarop om te praat. Jou e-posadres bly privaat.
zu: Uyamukela
Thepha [[Accept]]. Akukubizi lutho. Nobabili nithola i-imeyili: phendula kuyo ukuze nikhulume. Ikheli lakho le-imeyili lihlala liyimfihlo.
xh: Uyamkela
Cofa [[Accept]]. Akukuxabisi nto. Nobabini nifumana i-imeyile: phendula kuyo ukuze nithethe. Idilesi yakho ye-imeyile ihlala iyimfihlo.
nso: O a amogela
Kgotla [[Accept]]. Ga go go biditše selo. Le hwetša imeile ka bobedi: e arabe gore le boledišane. Aterese ya gago ya imeile e dula e le sephiri.

en: She is introduced
In her [[My Space]], [[Intros]] shows [[Accepted]] and her 1 Tuppence is spent. After the first lesson she can tap [[I hired them]].
af: Sy is voorgestel
In haar [[My Space]] wys [[Intros]] [[Accepted]] en haar 1 Tuppence is gebruik. Ná die eerste les kan sy [[I hired them]] tik.
zu: Useyethuliwe
Ku-[[My Space]] yakhe, [[Intros]] ikhombisa [[Accepted]] futhi i-Tuppence yakhe engu-1 isisetshenzisiwe. Ngemva komsebenzi angathepha [[I hired them]].
xh: Sele eziswe
Kwi-[[My Space]] yakhe, [[Intros]] ibonisa [[Accepted]] kwaye i-Tuppence yakhe e-1 isetyenzisiwe. Emva komsebenzi angacofa [[I hired them]].
nso: O tsebišitšwe
Go [[My Space]] ya gagwe, [[Intros]] e bontšha [[Accepted]] gomme Tuppence ya gagwe e 1 e šomišitšwe. Ka morago ga mošomo a ka kgotla [[I hired them]].

en: Pass Quick on
Tap [[Pass Quick on to someone]] and share it with a friend who teaches too.
af: Gee Quick aan
Tik [[Pass Quick on to someone]] en deel dit met 'n vriend wat ook onderrig gee.
zu: Dlulisela i-Quick
Thepha [[Pass Quick on to someone]] bese uyabelana ngayo nomngane naye ofundisayo.
xh: Dlulisela i-Quick
Cofa [[Pass Quick on to someone]] uze wabelane ngayo nomhlobo naye ofundisayo.
nso: Fetišetša Quick pele
Kgotla [[Pass Quick on to someone]] gomme o e abelane le mogwera yo le yena a rutago.
